methodology_changes.title: Enabled autonomous methodology evolution
Research becomes the basis for methodology; backtest benched until 2027-02-11
The screener scored stale prices: factor_scores cache bounded by the wrong tier
Weight changes come from research, not from the return series
The evidence base: five defects that made the observation count meaningless
Which runs are comparable to each other: the history gate
A price series that mixes two split scales is refused, not scored
The dashboard showed weights the scores were never multiplied by
The screener clipped values it then ranked, and published the clipped number
The risk category was 30% momentum wearing a risk label
The AI chat leaves the dashboard; every stock gains a deterministic "Why it ranks here"
The revisions category gets an actual revision, and stops being 78% earnings surprise
The published percentile means "best", not "largest", and the page now says so
The dashboard gains a sell-side surface, built to the shape the evidence allows
No hold band, and the rule for when one may be chosen
The tool states the cadence it is built for, and flags when a rank move is the inputs changing
The dashboard answers "how much?" with inputs, and never with a weight
Position weighting moves to equal, and the published methodology stops describing a scheme the tool does not use
Two-source metric inputs can now actually use their second source
The public methodology page is generated, so the 2026-09-25 corrections are now made where they survive a data run
The dashboard gains the one timing fact the evidence endorses: when each company next reports
